parties: Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited; Lalit Agarwal (Promoter)
headline: Lalit Agarwal files annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming no promoter share encumbrance in Agarwal Industrial Corporation for FY26
sum: Lalit Agarwal, Whole-Time Director and promoter of Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited, filed a mandatory annual disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) on April 3, 2026, confirming that neither he nor the promoter group created any encumbrance over shares held during FY26 (year ended March 31, 2026). This is a routine compliance filing required annually under the SAST Regulations.
implication: Annual Regulation 31(4) encumbrance declarations, though procedurally ministerial, serve as a key governance signal-the clean holding confirms no collateral pressure and supports credit rating stability for the bitumen-logistics business.
detail: The disclosure confirms that all direct and indirect shareholdings of Lalit Agarwal and the promoter group remained free of pledges or encumbrances throughout FY26. Promoter holding stood at approximately 57.2% as of the year-end. The filing was formally submitted to both BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited via digital signature. This routine annual certification is distinct from the substantive acquisition filings under Regulation 30 and is a hygiene compliance marker.
